title: Alkaline Water: Truth or Scam?
description:
Is alkaline water really a super drink or just another expensive pseudoscientific fad? In this episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we expose the myths behind alkaline water and the false promises made by gurus, YouTubers, and companies selling overpriced machines like Kangen water ionizers.

We’ll cover:

What alkaline water is and the science of pH.
Why adding cucumbers (pH 5.1–5.7) and lemons (pH 2–3) to water doesn’t magically make it alkaline.
The acid–ash hypothesis and why systematic reviews have debunked it.
How your body naturally regulates pH through breathing, kidneys, and excretion.
Why the only real effect of alkaline water is on your urine pH (expensive pee!).
False claims that alkaline water cures cancer, osteoporosis, and acidity, and what science actually says.
The one possible benefit: mild relief for acid reflux, though antacids work better and cheaper.
Why marketing, celebrity endorsements, and pseudoscience push people to waste money on it.

If you’ve searched for alkaline water benefits, Kangen water scam, alkaline diet myth, acid ash hypothesis, alkaline water cancer cure, alkaline water explained, this video gives you the scientific perspective.

👉 Don’t waste money on pseudoscience. Drink clean, safe water. And don’t forget to like, comment, share, and subscribe to support more myth-busting science videos!
